data.gender_notes: Aprameya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aprameya is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'apra' meaning 'unmeasurable' and 'meya' meaning 'great'. It is a name given to one who is considered to be incomparable or unmeasurable in terms of strength, wisdom, or power. The name Aprameya carries the meaning “Unmeasurable, Incomparable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aprameya usually hope their child will grow to embody unmeasurable, incomparable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
